# onetsolutions_instance_reinstall (Action)

Reinstalls an instance from an image, erasing its system disk and its snapshots.

-> **Terraform 1.14 or later.** This is an action: it runs only when invoked, with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.onetsolutions_instance_reinstall.<name>`, or when a resource's `action_trigger` lifecycle
block fires it (before or after the resource is created or updated, as its `events` say). It
stores nothing in the state. OpenTofu does not run actions: the provider works with it, without
them.

!> **Destructive.** A reinstall **erases the system disk** of the instance and **deletes all its
snapshots**, then installs `image_id` with the given SSH keys, One Click Apps and control panel.
Nothing on the disk can be recovered afterwards, except from a backup: take one first
(`onetsolutions_instance_backup`). `terraform plan` warns before every reinstall.

The instance keeps its id, size and billing. Its `onetsolutions_instance_snapshot` resources are
removed from the state at the next refresh, and recreated by the next apply if they are still
configured. The action waits until the new system is installed, up to `timeouts.invoke` (30
minutes by default), reporting each step.

## The instance's `image_id`

When an `onetsolutions_instance` manages the instance and `image_id` here differs from that
resource's `image_id`, set the resource's `image_id` to the new image as well, in the same
change. Otherwise the next plan sees the instance running another image and **replaces it**: that
orders a new instance and requests the cancellation of this one. `terraform plan` warns when the
image changes. Reinstalling the instance's current image needs no change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_image" "debian" {
  slug = "debian-13"
}

# Erases the system disk of the instance:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.onetsolutions_instance_reinstall.web
action "onetsolutions_instance_reinstall" "web" {
  config {
    instance_id = onetsolutions_instance.web.id
    image_id    = data.onetsolutions_image.debian.id
    ssh_key_ids = [onetsolutions_ssh_key.deploy.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_id` (String) The UUID of the image to install (see `onetsolutions_image`): the instance's current image to start afresh, or another one.
- `instance_id` (String) The UUID of the instance.

### Optional

- `allow_password_reset` (Boolean) Whether the console may change the operating system's password later. Defaults to `true`.
- `control_panel` (String) The slug or UUID of a control panel to install (see `onetsolutions_control_panels`).
- `install_management_key` (Boolean) Whether the OnetSolutions support SSH key is installed. Support and the console's tools (such as password reset) need it, and so do One Click Apps and control panels. Defaults to `true`.
- `one_click_app` (Block List) A One Click App installed with the new system; repeat the block for several. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--one_click_app))
- `organization_id` (String) The organization of the instance. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project of the instance. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) The UUIDs of the SSH keys (see `onetsolutions_ssh_key`) installed for the administrator account.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `volume_id` (String) The UUID of a volume configuration of the instance's size to install on. When unset, the instance keeps its current one.
